description: Initial baseline measurement
Added Pre-Action Safety Gate to responder.md — intervention restraint criteria for degradation vs outage, risk check framework, communication-over-action guidance
Enhanced documenter runbook template with command+expected output format, decision branches, per-step rollback, and Runbook Writing Rules section

Added Maintenance Window Planning Framework to operator.md — 7-step structured template with dependency mapping, risk ranking, per-item rollback, pre-flight checklist, go/no-go gates, and risk-aware sequencing

Added Preventive Task Dispatch (P3/P4) framework to dispatcher.md — urgency assessment (hard deadline, degradation trajectory, automation failure), structured task construction (5 required elements), example task template, and time-boxing guidance for non-outage items

Added Authentication Failure Remediation Procedures section to analyst.md + analyst expertise — machine account trust breakage remediation (re-join, verify, purge tickets per platform, rollback), cross-platform remediation checklist enforcing both Windows and Linux steps and escalating impact warnings

Added Tension Mediation Protocol to dispatcher.md — 5-step structured mediation procedure (acknowledge both positions, ground in evidence, apply framework default, synthesize not pick, assign concrete next steps) with synthesis examples for all four tensions and anti-patterns

Added Concern Severity Framework to scout.md — Critical/High/Medium/Low severity table with definitions, Security vs Operational concern split in output format, classification rules (patch currency flagging, dependency blast radius, justification for High/Critical), replaced flat Anomalies section with structured Security Concerns and Operational Concerns sections

Added Post-Incident Detection Review (kill chain timeline analysis, gap quantification, trigger analysis, improvement recommendations) and Defense Credit Protocol (structured defense acknowledgment with kill chain context) to hardener.md and expertise file

Added Decision Branch Framework to documenter.md — four divergence types (alternative root causes, step-level failures, environment variations, state divergence) with symptom-level examples and systematic branch identification guidance for runbook decision points

Enhanced documenter baseline template with structured sections (Network Configuration, Storage, Users and Security, Backup Configuration), Flagged Concerns table with severity/category/action/priority columns, and Normal State Baseline section with expected patterns for monitoring

Added expected failure output to remediation step template in documenter.md — remediation steps now require both Expected success and Expected failure output (matching diagnostic section), updated Runbook Writing Rule #1 to explicitly require both success and failure output for all commands

Added P1/P2 Incident Dispatch Framework to dispatcher.md — severity declaration with evidence, business impact statement, structured incident task (5 required elements including first action sequence), escalation branches (if-restored vs if-not-restored), and explicit tension call requirement

Added Partial Impact Investigation Framework to analyst.md — 5-step structured approach for partial-impact incidents (time-boundary analysis, state cache hypothesis with Kerberos/DNS/ARP/TLS examples, escalation prediction, partition test, cross-platform impact statement)

Added Dependency Chain Mapping Framework to scout.md — chain tracing method (consumer/provider identification, follow the data, shared infrastructure dependencies, criticality classification), structured chain output format with blast radius, and common chain patterns checklist (application stack, auth/identity, external connectivity, backup, DNS, monitoring, DHCP)

Added Kerberos Trust Failure Mechanism to analyst.md — explicit 5-step failure chain (shared secret desync → service ticket encryption mismatch → cached ticket masking → escalation pattern → total failure) with diagnostic indicators, filling the gap in C1 root cause identification

Integrated Automation Failure Dual-Problem Triage into P3/P4 Preventive Task Dispatch framework — merged standalone Automation Failure Principle into P3/P4 urgency assessment (automation failure makes hard deadline less trustworthy), added time-boxing escalation tier for automation failures, and restructured task construction to mandate both immediate fix and automation investigation in a single dispatch

Added Compromise Credential Cascade principle and explicit timeframe structure to hardener.md — mandatory credential rotation after compromise (all local/domain/service accounts on compromised host), service account audit trigger (one failure = audit all), structured Immediate/Short-term/Medium-term output format replacing flat Critical/Important/Minor

Added Per-Item Verification Templates to operator.md Step 7 — replaced generic post-check bullets with specific verification command templates per maintenance type (firewall, AD/DC, database, Linux/Windows OS, backup, Docker) and mandatory 3-part post-check structure (direct verification, downstream verification, monitoring confirmation)

Added Cross-Host Analysis section to scout.md output format — systematic comparison step (duplicate services/tooling, shared patch debt, backup coverage gaps, single points of failure, configuration drift patterns) placed before Security/Operational Concerns sections to ensure cross-host patterns are caught

Expanded Multi-Alert Protocol from 3 lines to structured 5-step framework — rapid severity sort, independence assessment, parallel dispatch construction with client context requirement, parallel/serial decision rules, and context maintenance for simultaneous alerts

Added Minimum Branch Coverage rule to documenter.md Runbook Writing Rule #3 — every diagnostic step must have one alternative-cause branch, every remediation step must have one step-level failure branch, with explicit flag for steps where no branch exists
